predictions: Ok, it's a pretty good season when a 15-8 week is your second worst of the entire season. And that's exactly what I got last week… a 15-8 that is my second worst. And those included two tiebreaker losses, an 11-10, and two 13-11s, giving me five picks that swung on one dart. Also had a 14-10 that could've gone to 1001 on one dart. These matches are so dang close so many weeks… not really sure how I've managed to post a 185-67 record (73.4% correct) so far. Still looking to climb…

Match of the week: (F Div.) Dart Side of the Moon @ Runs with Corks. Dart Side holds the match lead. The Corkers hold the point lead. If Dart Side wins, this race is pretty much over. But if the Corkers win, they move into the lead of a very tight race. With six of Dart Side's wins being by a single dart, their lead feels dicey as all get out. But it looks like the Corkers might be missing a few key pieces on this particular night. Wanted to go Cork, but now I have to take Dart Side. 13-11.

Match #2: (E Div.) Sharky's Machine @ Irish Ton. E division is such a close and exciting race that a week 12 match involving the next-to-last- place team is a super key pairing. That sixth place team has won 3 of their last 4, so this is anything but a gimme. In the end though, Machine has a solid point lead and is ready to finally take their spot atop E. 15-9.

Match #3: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Raging Bulls Eyes. With the recent Darty Minds mini-collapse, the B race is entirely reinvigorated. Dart Attack was poised to step right into the fray, but they got dismantled by Uber Out last week, so now it's only Raging that probably has time to climb into the fight for the top slot. Raging takes a tight one, 13-11.

Match #4: (D Div.) DD-214 @ Menace 2 Sobriety. The only way the D race isn't over is if Hump Day drops their last two. That means this pairing is now key in the race for 2nd (and the likely climb to C) instead. Why does DD struggle in DCkt? Don't know, but they do. M2S, 14-10.

Match #5: (A Div.) Liver Alliance @ Ring of Elements. The Bullies also have a big match tonight, but it really doesn't matter if they win or lose (unless Element loses here). That means it's mostly on Element this week to protect the big wk14 showdown. Element gets it done, 16-8.

Match #6: (C Div.) Off Constantly-Reboot @ Nine Lives. Wow, a 3rd vs. 6th game could be huge in determining which team ends up in a bottom-two slot (and likely drops to D next season). Pretty odd that a 5-4 3rd place is still in danger of that fate. Niners just get by, 13-11.

Match #7: (D Div.) Reload @ Bad Mutha Duckas. With Reload dropping 4 of their last 5, it's now entirely possible that either of these teams could end up joining Cheap Shots in E in the spring. I don't get to pick, but Reload really shouldn't be in E. Reload, 14-10.

Match #8: (E Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Death Throw. Now THIS is an awesome kind of match. Two teams with both simultaneously fighting to stay in the E title chase AND fighting to avoid falling to the bottom-two and a likely drop to F. E is crazy, pal. Rangers, 13-11.

Match #9: (G Div.) Killer Dee's @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. With the Dart Knights limping along and still having to face Nein Mark, did this matchup suddenly become a possible elimination match in the race for a top-two finish and a climb to F? We Throw It, 14-10.

Match #10: (F Div.) That's What She Said @ Rippin Darts. Both of these teams hold a point advantage on Shark Shooters, so a win here might very well equate to a climb out of the bottom two slots when it's all said and done. I will timidly take Rippin here, 13-11.

Match #11: (B Div.) Iceman's @ Darty Minds. It feels like a long time since Darty Minds won a match. They started 8-0, then won by forfeit, and now have lost two straight. Now they find themselves in a straight up point race with Show Me. Darty rebounds a bit, 14-10.
Match #12: (A Div.) Consistently Inconsis. @ Put It on Matt's Tab. Inconsistent wins more singles, wins more doubles, and hits more ASPs than the two teams ahead of them. Is this win #1? Sure, 13-11.
And the remaining 12 matches, sorted by division:
A Division: The Bullies 17, Lunatic Fringe 7.
B Division: Show Me 15, For Kids 9; Uber Out 14, Trippin Bulls 10.
C Division: Outlaws 16, Rif Raf 8; Bandits 13, Darty Sanchez 11.
D Division: Shooter McGavin 14, Cheap Shots 10.
E Division: Ton 80 Proof 16, Y.N.T.A. 8.
F Division: Sofa Kings 12, Shark Shooters 10; Possee 13, Bangin 11.
G Division: Dart Knights 15, Salute 9; Bottoms 15, Triple Shot 9.
